assessment: IPv4 resolution of the previously failing Google identity hostname works promptly in this isolated PS5 process at test time
Immediate IPv6 ENODNS for both hosts is consistent with IPv6 DNS not configured/available for this resolver context
This can be expected on an IPv4-only resolver path but the current test does not establish all PS5 IPv6 interface or DNS settings
This result does not explain a five-minute browser delay: no timeout or account-host failure reproduced here
No evidence justifies changing global DNS, clearing caches or disabling IPv6; native future clients can use verified IPv4 results while system browser behavior remains separate
